description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerFactory class that provides static methods to obtain and manage instances of user role manager objects within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to get, create, and update the user role manager instance, utilizing a service class for instantiation. The class employs singleton-like behavior to reuse instances unless explicitly refreshed.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class that manages singleton access to user role manager instances, with methods to retrieve, create, and refresh the user role manager.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the user role manager; creates it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getNewUserRoleManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the user role manager, typically used when session details change.

methods.name: updateUserRoleManager
methods.description: Refreshes the singleton user role manager instance with a new one, used when session details change.
